d: AHS is a Dubai-based group focused on ultra-luxury real estate development, strategic investments, and high-value ventures. The business operates at the intersection of premium brand building, investment storytelling, and exceptional customer experience, with a focus on creating a distinctive global presence in the luxury real estate sector.

This role is an opportunity to lead the digital marketing strategy and strengthen AHS's position as a leading ultra-luxury real estate brand. As Digital Marketing Director, you will oversee the digital ecosystem, drive high-impact campaigns, enhance brand visibility, and develop innovative strategies to engage high-net-worth individuals and international investors. Working closely with executive leadership, sales, and marketing teams, you will ensure digital initiatives translate into measurable business growth, qualified leads, and exceptional brand experiences.
q: 8+ years of digital marketing experience, including at least 3 years in a senior leadership or director-level position.
A degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.
Proven experience within luxury real estate development, premium property brands, or high-end hospitality and lifestyle sectors, with luxury real estate developer experience highly preferred.
Strong track record of developing and executing integrated digital marketing strategies for premium brands.
Extensive knowledge of paid media, performance marketing, SEO, SEM, social media, content marketing, and marketing automation.
Demonstrated experience managing substantial digital marketing budgets and delivering measurable ROI and lead generation results.
Strong understanding of marketing to ultra-high-net-worth individuals, international investors, and affluent audiences.
Experience with off-plan property launches, branded residences, luxury property campaigns, and international market positioning.
Proficiency in digital analytics and reporting tools, including Google Analytics 4, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, and CRM or marketing automation platforms.
Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary digital marketing teams and manage external agencies and strategic partnerships.
Strong commercial acumen, analytical capabilities, and the ability to translate business objectives into effective digital strategies.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to present strategies and performance insights to C-suite executives and senior leadership.
r: Develop and lead the overall digital marketing strategy, aligned with the company's business objectives and luxury brand positioning.
Oversee digital campaigns across paid media, social media, search engines, websites, email marketing, and other digital platforms.
Drive digital lead generation strategies to attract qualified high-net-worth individuals and international property investors.
Lead digital performance, analytics, and optimisation, ensuring measurable ROI and continuous improvement across all channels.
Oversee social media strategy, content distribution, and digital brand storytelling across relevant platforms.
Manage digital marketing budgets, media planning, campaign performance, and resource allocation.
Lead and mentor the digital marketing team, while managing relationships with external agencies, media partners, and technology providers.
Collaborate closely with sales, CRM, and creative teams to align digital campaigns with lead management, conversion, and customer engagement objectives.
Oversee website performance, SEO strategy, digital user experience, and marketing technology initiatives.
Establish reporting frameworks and present digital performance, insights, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership.
Stay ahead of digital trends, emerging technologies, and innovative marketing approaches relevant to the luxury real estate market.

d: The Foundations squad owns the platform that makes Lean's AI ambitions real — the shared libraries, developer infrastructure, and agentic loops that engineers across the company depend on every day. As Staff Engineer, you'll be the technical heartbeat of the team: the person who makes the hard architectural calls, keeps standards high under delivery pressure, and ensures that what we build today doesn't become tomorrow's bottleneck.

Lean is the leading financial infrastructure provider in the Middle East. We power some of the region's largest companies with APIs that enable payments, account verification, financial data access, and other critical financial infrastructure.

What started as the region's pioneering Open Banking platform and quickly became the de facto leader in account aggregation and payment initiation in the region is now becoming something bigger: a multi-product infrastructure company powering payments, data, and lending across MENA.

We've processed billions of dollars in transactions. We're trusted by 350+ clients — from Tabby and Tas'heel to Hungerstation — and backed by General Catalyst, Sequoia, and Shorooq. Our $67.5M Series B was just the beginning. We're expanding into new markets, opening offices, acquiring businesses, and building capabilities that didn't exist here before.
q: Staff Engineer level or equivalent — you've operated at this level and know what it means to lead technically without hierarchy
Habitual AI-assisted developer — you use AI tooling as a natural, daily part of how you write, review, and reason about code
Deep backend engineering experience: distributed systems, APIs, and reliability at scale
Java and Spring Boot — our core stack; non-negotiable
Strong system design and architectural judgement: opinionated, defensible, and intellectually honest when better evidence arrives
Active service ownership mindset — observability, alerting, SLOs, and incident response are part of your job, not someone else's
Comfortable leading without authority: you influence through credibility, not title
Strong communicator — you can hold a technical conversation with an engineer and a strategic one with a VP
Invested in the people around you — mentoring and growing junior engineers is something you do because you care, not because it's on your job description
Experience with AI/ML integration or agentic systems (LLM orchestration, agent frameworks, production prompt engineering)
Experience building internal developer platforms or shared libraries
Background in fintech, open banking, payments infrastructure, or financial data APIs

NB. While we think the above experience could be important, we’re keen to hear from people that believe they have valuable experience to bring to the role. If you identify with the team and mission, but not all of our requirements, then please still apply!!
r: Drive architectural decisions for the Foundations squad — setting direction on system design that balances robustness, reliability, and pragmatism, and defending those decisions with clarity
Serve as the technical voice of the team externally — building trusted relationships with other Staff Engineers and EMs across the org, and contributing to Lean's technical advisory group
Own and evolve the team's shared libraries and platform components (including Commons) that the wider engineering organisation depends on
Stay deeply embedded in team operations — spotting friction, championing improvements to processes and service hygiene, and driving change without formal authority
Lead by example on operational excellence: observability, alerting, SLOs, and incident response as first-class engineering concerns
Bring informed, opinionated perspective on AI and agentic systems — staying current with the industry, pushing the team's thinking, and maintaining high standards as the space evolves fast
Mentor and coach more junior engineers, investing in those around you as much as in the code
x: We’re building the financial infrastructure for MENA. Not as a slogan, as a fact.

Since 2019, we’ve become the first regulated Open Banking and Open Finance company operating across the UAE and Saudi Arabia. We’ve processed billions of dollars. We connect millions of accounts. We enable companies like Binance, Careem, and Etisalat to build products that were previously impossible in this region.

Our recent $67.5M Series B from General Catalyst and Sequoia isn’t just validation: it’s fuel. We’re expanding into new markets, launching new products, and setting the pace for what financial innovation looks like in MENA.
We solve hard problems. We move fast. We hold ourselves to a high standard. And we’re looking for people who’ve done this before to help us do it right.
If you’re motivated by building something that lasts, not just something that scales, Lean is where you need to be.

Not only do we offer competitive salaries, private healthcare, and flexible office hours, but we also insist that every member of the team hold a meaningful equity stake in the business to ensure long-term alignment. We'd love you to join us for this journey!
